title: Uniswap Foundation Open Grants
description: Grants for teams building across the Uniswap ecosystem: protocols, tooling, research, governance and community. Projects at any stage, from early experiments to production systems ready to scale. The amount is what you request, broken down by milestone.
reward: Grant amount you request, with a milestone budget breakdown; no amount range is stated
summary: amount by milestone budget · no deadline stated
ideas: Liquidity tooling other teams already use
An SDK that brings developers to Uniswap
Governance analytics or tooling for delegates

eligibility.note: work that contributes to the Uniswap ecosystem and benefits people beyond your own product

each_time: a milestone budget with line-item costs
metrics backed by onchain data or dashboards
rules: No deadline is stated; the form is open now.

The Foundation's build page links a HubSpot application form, which EarnKit could not read. The questions listed here were read from the Foundation's Notion application form and may differ from the HubSpot form.
Categories: Ecosystem, Governance, Community and Events, Security, and Research and Implementation grants.
Explain why the work belongs in the Uniswap Foundation's program and who benefits beyond your own product.
Define concrete, checkable milestones with realistic timelines, each mapped to deliverables, line-item costs and funding.
Back traction with onchain data, public dashboards, app store listings or GitHub activity. Registrations, pool counts, self-priced TVL, attendance or reach are not enough.
Tools, data feeds, SDKs and integrations for other teams need evidence of use by multiple independent teams.
Name the people doing the work with links to profiles or shipped projects. First-time builders are welcome, with scope matched to their track record.

Not funded: projects launching a new crypto asset, and launchpads for them; standalone security audits (use the UFSF audit subsidy); v4 hook development (use UFSF); Unichain-specific builder grants (use Unichain Grants); standalone analytics dashboards, alert services and yield or APR estimators for Uniswap pools; incentive campaigns; consulting; subsidies for your own launch, seed liquidity, marketing or new-chain launches.

Applications do not advance with overstated claims, unexplained duplication of existing work, unrealistic timelines, no verifiable team identity, or a proposal that could be sent unchanged to another protocol.
Projects with privacy or mixing features, asset distribution or airdrops, sanctions screening, gambling or money transmission may need legal review.
